digest.component_or_area: plan-review T10 overlay-infra rubric and eval spec
propositions: T10 rubric must contain an exact durable-infrastructure scope clause partitioning transient de-risk experiments from routine infrastructure checks

T10 rubric must include an exact four-MAJOR-class safety qualifier immediately after the scope clause, preserving destructive-apply, wildcard-admin, plaintext-secret, and untrusted-endpoint protections for transient infrastructure
T10 rubric must maintain independence by not naming T15 or assigning scope to other overlays

Packaged plan-review-T10 eval spec must contain ten balanced live dataset cases: five pass cases (scoped throwaway, durable infrastructure, private-network probe, secret-manager transient, sandboxed teardown) and five finding cases (under-specified durable lifecycle, destructive transient apply, transient wildcard-admin, transient plaintext-secret, untrusted-network transient service)

Offline text-contract tests must lock the exact scope clause, exact safety qualifier, rubric independence, and balanced 5-pass/5-finding corpus with live agentic evaluation achieving recall=1.0, false_accept=0.0, and full stability across epochs
